Bengals vs Commanders DraftKings Showdown Picks: Monday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Monday Night Football, November 23 · NFL Week 11 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 22, 12:04 PM ET

Joe Burrow has the highest SPAGS projection in the Bengals at Commanders DraftKings Showdown: 22.6 points at $11,000 FLEX, 33.8 at captain for $16,500. Across 10,000 simulations Burrow holds 70% of the winning-lineup credit.

Jayden Daniels has the largest captain share: 15.8% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Daniels at captain. The model has him running 6.3 times. Ja'Marr Chase is the next captain in line, at 15.4%. The model gives him 9.2 targets on 35.4 routes.

Cincinnati is a 6-point favorite, and the implied totals are 30.25 for the Bengals and 24.25 for the Commanders.

Behind Burrow, Daniels and Chase, the next projections are Chase Brown (17.6, $9,400), Tee Higgins (17.2, $10,600) and Rachaad White (12.3, $6,200).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 22, 12:04 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 10,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

Chris Spags' latest NFL DFS breakdown on the Splash Play NFL channel.

MNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Jayden Daniels, WAS QB ($10,000 FLEX / $15,000 CPT)

Jayden Daniels holds 15.8% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $15,000 and the 21.9-point SPAGS model projection becomes 32.9 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 6.3 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Daniels averaged 21.9 points with a simulated floor of 12.8 and a ceiling of 41.1. He holds 68% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 15.8% as the captain and 52.2% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Ja'Marr Chase, CIN WR ($11,600 FLEX / $17,400 CPT)

Ja'Marr Chase holds 15.4% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $17,400 and the 21.4-point SPAGS model projection becomes 32.1 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 9.2 targets on 35.4 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Chase averaged 21.6 points with a simulated floor of 8.5 and a ceiling of 44.2. He holds 54% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 15.4% as the captain and 38.9% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Joe Burrow, CIN QB ($11,000 FLEX / $16,500 CPT)

Joe Burrow holds 12.4% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $16,500 and the 22.6-point SPAGS model projection becomes 33.8 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. Across 10,000 simulations Burrow averaged 22.6 points with a simulated floor of 13.7 and a ceiling of 42.2. He holds 70% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 12.4% as the captain and 57.3% in a FLEX spot.

Top FLEX projections for Bengals vs Commanders

Chase Brown, CIN RB ($9,400 FLEX / $14,100 CPT)

Chase Brown carries the 4th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 17.6 DraftKings points for a $9,400 FLEX salary ($14,100 at captain). The model gives him 14.5 carries and 5.5 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Brown averaged 17.7 points with a simulated floor of 5.6 and a ceiling of 34.8. He holds 49% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 10.8% as the captain and 38.7% in a FLEX spot.

Tee Higgins, CIN WR ($10,600 FLEX / $15,900 CPT)

Tee Higgins carries the 5th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 17.2 DraftKings points for a $10,600 FLEX salary ($15,900 at captain). The model gives him 7.1 targets on 34.4 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Higgins averaged 17.1 points with a simulated floor of 4.2 and a ceiling of 43.1. He holds 36% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 10.1% as the captain and 26.3% in a FLEX spot.

Rachaad White, WAS RB ($6,200 FLEX / $9,300 CPT)

Rachaad White carries the 6th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 12.3 DraftKings points for a $6,200 FLEX salary ($9,300 at captain). The model gives him 11.5 carries and 2.8 targets. Across 10,000 simulations White averaged 12.4 points with a simulated floor of 2.9 and a ceiling of 26.9. He holds 39% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 5.9% as the captain and 32.8% in a FLEX spot.

Stefon Diggs, WAS WR ($8,400 FLEX / $12,600 CPT)

Stefon Diggs carries the 7th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 12.1 DraftKings points for an $8,400 FLEX salary ($12,600 at captain). The model gives him 7.1 targets on 25.2 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Diggs averaged 11.9 points with a simulated floor of -0.1 and a ceiling of 37.1. He holds 26% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 7.9% as the captain and 18.2% in a FLEX spot.

Across 10,000 simulations Okonkwo averaged 11.7 points with a simulated floor of 2.4 and a ceiling of 25.4. He holds 46% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 7.0% as the captain and 39.1% in a FLEX spot.

Value: Samaje Perine, CIN RB ($4,400 FLEX / $6,600 CPT)

Samaje Perine projects for 8.3 DraftKings points at a $4,400 FLEX salary, 1.88 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 6.6 carries and 1.4 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Perine averaged 8.3 points with a simulated floor of 2.5 and a ceiling of 15.4. He holds 19% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 1.1% as the captain and 17.8% in a FLEX spot.

Bengals vs Commanders DraftKings Showdown FAQ

Who is the best captain for the Bengals vs Commanders DraftKings Showdown?

Jayden Daniels holds the largest captain share of simulated winning lineups at 15.8%, ahead of Ja'Marr Chase (15.4%) and Joe Burrow (12.4%), across 10,000 simulations.

What is the best DraftKings Showdown lineup for Bengals vs Commanders?

Build around Jayden Daniels at captain with Joe Burrow, Chase Brown and Rachaad White at FLEX. That is the core of the lineup that won the most simulations in Chris Spags' pool (23 of 10,000 simulated contests), and it leaves $8,400 for the last two FLEX spots.

Who has the highest projection in Bengals vs Commanders DraftKings Showdown?

Joe Burrow leads the SPAGS model at 22.6 DraftKings points for $11,000 at FLEX, or 33.8 points at captain for $16,500.

What are the DraftKings salaries for Bengals vs Commanders Showdown?

Ja'Marr Chase is the most expensive player at $11,600 FLEX and $17,400 at captain. All 28 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

What are the best value plays in Bengals vs Commanders DraftKings Showdown?

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to Chig Okonkwo (11.8 points at $4,000), Samaje Perine (8.3 points at $4,400) and Dohnte Meyers (6.7 points at $3,600).

What is the Bengals vs Commanders spread and total?

The Bengals are a 6-point favorite in a game totaled at 54.5, with implied team totals of 30.25 for the Bengals and 24.25 for the Commanders.
